name: esp32emu
description: Fast ESP32 (Xtensa LX6, dual-core) emulator — a WASM-compiled Xtensa core with native peripherals, runnable from Node.js and web workers.

scripts.build:wasm: cd engine-wasm && cargo build --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown && cp target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/esp_engine_wasm.wasm ../src/engine/esp-xtensa/esp_engine_wasm.wasm
scripts.test: ln -sf tests/rom rom && ENGINE=wasm node tests/wasm-bench.mjs && ENGINE=wasm node tests/test-wasm-standalone.mjs && ENGINE=wasm node tests/test-wasm-worker-init.mjs && ENGINE=wasm node tests/test-package-smoke.mjs && node tests/test-micropython.mjs
